decisions.reasoning: META has shown a strong pre-run into earnings (+8.2% average over last 4 quarters) and beat EPS estimates in each of the last four quarters, but post-earnings reactions have been inconsistent, including downside follow-through after prior beats. Current price action shows bullish momentum with a 10% recovery off recent lows, and IV is elevated at 106%, reflecting rich pricing for options. The options skew favors calls slightly, but the high IV environment and lack of clear directional bias from historical gaps (averaging <1.5%) support a volatility-focused, non-directional approach. A strangle allows defined risk exposure to a large post-earnings move while avoiding IV crush on the ATM straddle.
